milestone.describes: Chapter one is playable: dialogue advances, the arrow-marked object responds, the quest letter opens, both hidden Eurekas are collected and counted, and the footprints lead to the next room.

steps.expect: The social-SDK sign-up panel over the main menu.
Panel gone, menu brightens. The other button opens a sign-in that still dies on a nil string -- do not press it.
Profiles on a fresh save; Continue / New Game / Back when a save exists.
Enter Your Name.
Name accepted. Must be a scancode -- see notes.
Back at the menu with the profile selected.
The introduction cutscene begins.
Cutscene ends on chapter one's title card, then the living room with Jim and Frank in dialogue.
Next line. Any tap on the speech scroll advances it.
The interaction tutorial card.
Living room, with a red arrow over the scroll on the table.
The characters react. This is the first proof that input reaches the game rather than the menus.
The desk close-up, with the letter glowing.
The grandfather's letter, upright and readable, with a Skip button.
The Eureka tutorial card.
Free-roam living room with two Eurekas highlighted.
The window-pane Eureka is collected.
"Whoa! Two Eurekas!" -- the game counting them is the state change that proves the loop.
Footprints appear near the guitar, showing where the player can walk.
The study with a lit fireplace and new dialogue. Scene-to-scene navigation works, so the loop persists.

notes: Return must be injected as a raw scancode (keybd_event with KEYEVENTF_SCANCODE, scancode 0x1C). SDL never sees a virtual-key-only synthetic Return, and SendKeys "{ENTER}" does not work either: the characters arrive but the key does not.
Window captures include the border and title bar. Client x = capture x - 8, client y = capture y - 31 on Windows 11 at the default theme. Every coordinate here is already a client coordinate.
The dialogue steps are deliberately one tap per step rather than a repeat count, so a replay report names the exact line it stopped on.
With a save present, 'play' lands on Continue / New Game / Back instead of the profile list; Continue at [847, 114] goes straight into the saved scene, and the profile-creation steps are skipped.
